about: What changed on nfs3.xyz, day by day. Kinds: new, improved, fixed. Days run 05:00 to 05:00 Polish time. tools/discord/changelog.mjs posts them to Discord.

items: Discord server for help, bug reports, ideas and finding races: Join our Discord in the menu.
What's New: this list of changes, day by day.
iPhone: touch buttons no longer get stuck, and holding one no longer highlights text.
iPhone: sound plays with the silent switch on, and comes back after a call or switching apps.
Lap Records on the start page: every racer's best lap on each track, in both directions, with tags for mirrored, night, weather and instant steering. Laps driven with mods on don't count.
Phones and tablets: on-screen buttons to steer, brake and accelerate; a finger on the picture works as the mouse.
iPhone: the game files now save on iOS 18, and the page shows how to get fullscreen with Add to Home Screen.
Instant steering (Game Settings): the wheels turn to full lock at once, like with a joystick back in the day.
The graphics options list every mode as 32-bit colour, which is how the game is actually drawn.
The game no longer runs out of memory after about 30 races in one session.
Browsers without WebGL 2 (hardware acceleration off) get a clear message before anything downloads.
Links to the sister sites: nfs2se.xyz (NFS II SE) and nfs4.xyz (High Stakes).
Game Settings on the start page: fullscreen, FPS counter, intro movies, unlocks, controllers, resolution, sharpness and volume.
Mods switch: rata_536's remastered cars, police and traffic cars and loading screens, on or off with one click.
Long online sessions no longer crash with an out-of-memory error.
The game runs in one tab at a time; a second tab used to break the download.
The server and online rooms are better protected against abuse.
Widescreen and HD: 16:9 and 16:10 modes up to 3840×2160. The game starts in the biggest mode that fits your screen.
Gamepads and steering wheels, set up in the game's own Options › Controllers.
Everything unlocked from the start: the bonus cars and Empire City.
Fullscreen button in the corner, and Alt+Enter.
The start page now looks like the game's 1998 main menu, with new icons.
Smoother online races: your car reacts at once even when someone else hosts.
Full frame rate in browsers on Windows (it was stuck at 25 to 30 fps).
Game downloads in Safari came out damaged. Damaged downloads are now found and repaired.
A black screen at start caused by the intro movies; they are skipped by default.
After an update, the browser could mix old and new files and crash.
nfs3.xyz is public: the game files download automatically, once, and Start is one click after that.
Online lobby: a room browser, named rooms with passwords, and invite links.
Your lobby name is your name in the game.
The start page shows who is online and racing, the most active racers, and a daily race at 20:00 with notifications.
Races in 800×600 and 1024×768 instead of only 640×480.
Online: lost packets are recovered, and the best-host pick looks at frame rate as well as ping.
When a newer version is on the server, the page offers a reload.
A black screen at start in Safari when the browser held the sound back.
First version: Need for Speed III: Hot Pursuit (with VEG's Modern Patch) recompiled to WebAssembly and drawn with WebGL 2.
Online races in the browser: the game's LAN (IPX) mode over direct browser-to-browser links, with a relay when those can't connect.
